cohort: Fetuses and newborns diagnosed with perinatal testicular torsion between 2002 and 2013 at a single medical center.
finding: Prenatal diagnosis of unilateral testicular torsion is rare, and because the twisted testicle cannot be salvaged, induced delivery and prompt surgery are not recommended.
gest_age: Third trimester in 2 cases, newborn in 3 cases
